sections.title: Begin with the decision
sections.body: The first paragraph should give the reader a useful conclusion. Each section then supplies the evidence needed to assess it.

sections.title: Let the evidence carry the page
sections.body: Use a chart when it makes a comparison easier to see. Put the source beside the claim, explain the measure, and name any limits that affect the conclusion.

sections.title: Leave a useful next step
sections.body: Close with the question, choice, or observation the reader should carry into the next conversation.
